description: Search for Amazon products by keyword, ASIN, or Amazon URL with optional filters for brand, category, price range, stock status, and sorting. Returns product IDs for use with other tools. Rate limited to 20 req/min without an API key — use the register_api_key tool for 120 req/min.

brand.description: Filter by brand name (e.g. Apple, Samsung, Sony)

category.description: Filter by category (e.g. Laptops, Headphones, TVs)

in_stock.description: When true, only returns in-stock products. When false, returns both in-stock and out-of-stock products (it does NOT filter to out-of-stock only). Defaults to true.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-50). Defaults to 20.

max_price.description: Maximum price in the region's currency (e.g. 500 for £500)

min_price.description: Minimum price in the region's currency (e.g. 100 for £100)

query.description: Search keyword, Amazon ASIN (e.g. B08N5WRWNW), or Amazon product URL. Optional when using brand/category filters.

region.description: Country code (e.g. uk, us, de). Defaults to uk.

sort_by.description: Sort order for results. Defaults to relevance.

name: search_products
